description: Vue watchers of one component whose order in a flush the compiler proves to be declaration order (docs/design/REACTIVITY-ALIASING.md, watcher order), all logging into one array: a later watcher's signals are a subset of what an earlier watcher reads in every run (a ref; a record field through a prop, with another prop the parent's render updates), in both write orders of the flush, the earlier one also reading an array's length; two watchers no handler triggers together
